name: escalate_to_human
description: Escalates the current conversation to a human support agent. Use this tool when the customer explicitly asks for a human, when the issue is too complex to resolve automatically, or when the customer expresses strong frustration.

reason.description: A concise summary of why the conversation is being escalated, e.g. 'Customer requests refund for damaged item'.

urgency_level.description: The urgency of the escalation: 'low' for general inquiries, 'medium' for unresolved issues, 'high' for angry customers or time-sensitive problems, 'critical' for legal threats or safety concerns.
